This should not be fixed by simply reverting #34693. candidates.title: [Bug] Kimi-K3 strict tool-call grammar: additionalProperties dilutes a named property's type constraint
candidates.snippet: ## Describe the bug  For a Kimi-K3 **strict** tool whose parameter is an object schema declaring **both** a named property and a schema-valued `additionalProperties`, the compiled xgrammar constraint lets the **named** property be satisfied by the (looser) `additionalProperties` schema instead of its own type. candidates.title: compressed-tensors: float-quantized (FP8) checkpoints silently load as 4-bit affine
candidates.snippet: ### Summary  `mlx_lm` treats every `compressed-tensors` checkpoint whose `format` it doesn't explicitly recognise as **4-bit affine**, including `float-quantized` (FP8). The stored tensors are `F8_E4M3`, so their bytes get reinterpreted as packed 4-bit integers rather than rejected.  ### Where  `mlx_lm/utils.py`, in the `compressed-tensors` branch.
